testcase.name: Scenario: Double-click an inactive ribbon tab before cycling its display: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-display-source/features/application/ribbon-display/ribbon-display.feature:256:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Double-click an inactive ribbon tab before cycling its display ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the full 3D Model ribbon is visible ✔ And the ribbon display control is set to cycle through all modes ✔ When the user double-clicks the inactive Tools tab ✔ Then Tools becomes the active tab ✔ And the full Tools ribbon is visible ✔ When the user double-clicks the active Tools tab ✔ Then the Tools ribbon displays panel buttons ✔ When the user double-clicks the active Tools tab three more times ✔ Then the full Tools ribbon is visible again
